[Section] Neural Collective Entity Linking
[source_id=42] NCEL incorporates GCN into a deep neural network to utilize structured graph information for collectively feature abstraction, while differs from conventional GCN in the way of applying the graph. Instead of the entire graph, only a subset of nodes is “visible" to each node in our proposed method, and then the overall structured information shall be reached in a chain-like way. Fixing the size of the subset, NCEL is further speeded up by batch techniques and GPUs, and is efficient to large-scale data.
